name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 29 October 2025 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35 as regards technical provisions, long-term guarantee measures, own funds, equity risk, spread risk on securitisation positions, other standard formula capital requirements, reporting and disclosure, proportionality and group solvency
part_text:
The European Parliament is blocking a European Commission rule on how insurance companies must hold capital. Parliament says the Commission went beyond what the law allowed and ignored expert advice. The rule would have cut capital requirements for insurers' risky investments, including some securitisations, without evidence. Parliament also criticises the Commission for leaving out higher capital charges for crypto-assets and fossil fuel investments, despite expert recommendations. The resolution objects to the rule, so it cannot enter into force.

- **What changes:** The Commission's insurance capital rule is blocked and cannot take effect.
- **Who it affects:** Insurance and reinsurance companies, and their supervisors, across the EU.
- **What happens next:** Parliament tells the Commission the rule cannot enter into force and informs member states.
